svg.text: Bootcamp DC1/DC2: partner traffic path (L2 edge → IPsec / direct attach → MPLS L3VPN → s100 → firewall → DIST → F5)
AS 20 · namespace bootcamp_dc · as observed read-only on 2026-11-22 · source: docs/design/bootcamp-dc-intent.md §2 · nothing here is in Infrahub as intent yet
each RR: LAG Po1 = Gi1/1 + Gi1/2
Today: DC1 PEs reach s100 + F5 ranges only via DC2
track UP → serving BOTH DCs today
IPsec partner: IKEv2/ESP from 100.120.0.1 over the shared underlay; the edge switch (HSRP g11) routes it to the PE-VPN VIP 130.221.251.62.
Tunnel300 (VTI) lands in VRF v300; eBGP AS 1170 ↔ AS 20. Direct partners (v211, v183) attach instead on PE-LL3 dot1q sub-interfaces with HSRP.
L3VPN: export-map export-s100-shared tags non-private routes RT 20:199; VPNv4 to the site's two RRs over MPLS (OSPF + LDP labels for loopbacks).
The RRs (also the s100 gateway pair) import 20:199 into s100; s100 statics send traffic to the local firewall, only while IP SLA to the DIST answers.
Firewall policy, then vlan 601 to the DIST.
DIST routes to the F5 VIP /24s (and announces them over eBGP); the F5 load-balances to the pool members.
s100 exports RT 20:100 → every partner VRF imports only 20:100 → the PE sends the partner only 145.245.114.0/24 + 145.245.115.0/24.
Isolation: no partner VRF imports 20:199, so partners never see each other's routes. Management for every device is VRF oob 10.10.10.0/24 (not drawn).
= gap ID from the design doc §8
